EMERGENCY PROCEDURES (v1)
=========================

BUILDING EVACUATION
- Alarm sounds: Exit via nearest stairwell (do not use elevators).
- Gather at designated meeting point: North parking lot.
- Wait for all-clear from building management.

MEDICAL EMERGENCY
- Call 911 first.
- Notify the security desk: (555) 010-1010

SEVERE WEATHER
- Move away from windows.
- Follow security desk announcements.
